post.text:
WATCH: Graph shows H-1B visa holders legally migrating to the United States.

https://t.co/wHaPWyQtLD
post.author_description: Independent digital media outlet covering global news and current affairs, doing analysis and commentary. Not affiliated with President Trump.

description.description: A series of infographic maps illustrating the cumulative number of H-1B visa workers in the United States from 2016 to projected 2025. Each frame displays a map of the US populated with colored dots representing workers from various countries of origin, with India being the most prominent. Sidebars and tables track the growth, showing a sharp increase from 812,775 workers in 2016 to a projected 5,152,824 in 2023 and 6,932,647 by 2025.
